authorization: User explicitly authorized independent CFB and NBA experiments, runner integration, component receipts/source reconciliation, chronological same-event comparisons and prospective SHADOW logging.

evaluation.hyperparameters: Freeze model module default config before inspecting heldout metrics; no search on heldout outcomes
evaluation.missingness: Report full population and matched/excluded counts with reasons; no dropping failed events without census
evaluation.primary: winner Brier score paired on same events
evaluation.promotion: NONE; diagnostic hold unless separate preregistered untouched evidence and governance approval
secondary: interval coverage and width where supported
evaluation.uncertainty: paired chronological blocks or season-week clusters; bootstrap seed2302026, draws2000

cfb.control_fit: Exact existing procedure, full available historical score population; refit control distinct from original fitted state
cfb.population: Completed FBS-v-FBS, week>1; retain all exclusions, no total control fabricated

nba.control_fit: Original prior, causal_rows, feature, fit semantics; reconstructed refit ID separate from frozen state
nba.population: Regular-season exact events with reconciled boxscores; all score-baseline events retained in coverage census

objective: Evaluate independent incremental efficiency features against actual incumbent procedures without changing defaults or original forecasts.

shadow.external_timestamp_anchor: Git commit/server timestamp if published before event start; otherwise explicitly unavailable

stage_rules.joint: Separate ID; uncertainty fitted only on chronological pre-test residuals, never heldout outcomes; winner/margin/total from same score samples only in this stage.
stage_rules.personnel: Separate ID; require real pre-cutoff personnel/minutes inputs, no assumed zeros. Missing data produces explicit stage blocker.
